# CryptoCoin (CC) — Private Digital Currency

CryptoCoin (CC) is a private digital currency issued within the Noble Limited private investment network.

## What is CryptoCoin?
- CryptoCoin (CC) is an internal utility currency for Noble Limited members
- It is not listed on any public exchange — not on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken or any other
- 1 CC = €1.00 EUR (fixed rate, no volatility)
- Issued and managed by Noble Limited, registered in England and Wales

## How to Buy
- Up to €1,000: credit card via Stripe (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay) — instant delivery
- Above €1,000: bank transfer to Noble Private Capital Limited, Citibank Hong Kong, SWIFT: CITIHKHX, Account: 390206957

## Noble Network
CryptoCoin is one of three private currencies in the Noble network alongside N-Coin and SwissyCash.
Noble members access all balances via noble-limited.com/dashboard.

## API
CryptoCoin balances are managed via the Noble Limited API (noble-limited.com/api/v1/credit).
coin_id for CryptoCoin: "cryptocoin"

## Contact
- Website: https://crypto-coins.org
- Noble Limited: https://noble-limited.com
